versions.changelog:
Initial release of brief-builder for structured requirements gathering.

- Interviews users with targeted, incremental questions to turn vague requests into clear, actionable briefs.
- Gathers essential brief elements: goal, audience, context, scope, voice, and success criteria.
- Follows up on vague responses and proposes defaults when needed, all while avoiding over-questioning.
- Produces a structured brief ready for handoff to the most appropriate skill.
- Ensures the process is conversational, focusing on clarity and completeness without overwhelming the user.
